summary: Uxin Ltd filed a 6-K announcing the closing of a US$15 million tranche of a previously announced US$50 million share subscription from NIO Capital affiliates and Prestige Shine Group, at US$0.00953 per Class A ordinary share (US$2.859 per ADS). The filing is a progress update on an existing capital raise, not a new special situation. The registrant is the issuer. No board recommendation, advisor, or unusual structural features beyond standard closing conditions are noted. This is a routine disclosure of a partial closing under existing subscription agreements, not an event triggering a special-situation classification.
